description: This file defines a plugin for the openclaw system that integrates the OpenAI Codex provider, including model resolution, OAuth authentication, catalog entries, and transport configuration.

methods.name: isOpenAICodexBaseUrl
methods.description: Checks if a given URL matches the OpenAI Codex base URL pattern.

methods.name: normalizeCodexTransport
methods.description: Normalizes the transport settings of a ProviderRuntimeModel to ensure correct API and base URL.

methods.name: resolveCodexForwardCompatModel
methods.description: Resolves and normalizes a model based on its ID, applying specific configurations for known models.

methods.name: refreshOpenAICodexOAuthCredential
methods.description: Refreshes OAuth credentials for the Codex provider, handling token refresh and error cases.

methods.name: runOpenAICodexOAuth
methods.description: Performs OAuth login flow for OpenAI Codex, returning authentication result.

methods.name: buildOpenAICodexAuthDoctorHint
methods.description: Provides a hint message for deprecated profiles.

methods.name: buildSyntheticCatalogEntry
methods.description: Creates a catalog entry for a model based on a template and specific model parameters.

methods.name: buildOpenAICodexProviderPlugin
methods.description: Constructs and returns the plugin object integrating OpenAI Codex with the openclaw system.
